town.text: Town Folk: after you WIN a round, draw 1 card.

rod.text: Rødnisser: you decide who plays first in round 1.

blaa.text: Blånisser: you WIN ties (a drawn round counts as yours).

natt.text: Night Creatures: after every round, one random unit of yours stays on the board.

fjord.text: Fjord Folk: at the start of round 3, 2 random units from your discard pile return to your board.

cards.name: Snøstorm
cards.line: Every Street row drops to 1 for both sides.
cards.text: Snowstorm (classic Biting Frost): both Streets drop to 1 per unit.

cards.name: Tåke
cards.line: Something is in the fog. The Rooftops drop to 1 for both.
cards.text: Fog (classic Impenetrable Fog): both Rooftops drop to 1 per unit.

cards.name: Regn
cards.line: The Workshops flood. Their rows drop to 1.
cards.text: Rain (classic Torrential Rain): both Workshops drop to 1 per unit.

cards.name: Tø
cards.line: The thaw. All weather ends.
cards.text: Thaw (classic Clear Weather): removes all weather.

cards.name: Julehorn
cards.line: Someone blows it. Everyone in the row suddenly tries twice as hard.
cards.text: Yule Horn (classic Commander's Horn): doubles one row of yours. One per row.

cards.name: Brann!
cards.line: Who left the stove on? Burns the strongest unit(s) on the whole board.
cards.text: Blaze (classic Scorch): burns the strongest non-Legend unit(s) on the whole board.

cards.name: Lokkedukke
cards.line: Looks just like you. Swap it for one of your units.
cards.text: Dummy (classic Decoy): swap with one of your board units (not a Legend), which returns to your hand.

cards.name: Chris
cards.line: "Okay but what if I just walk up to it?"
cards.text: Legend: immune to weather, Blaze, Dummy and all boosts.

cards.name: Martin
cards.line: "Was that you or the house?"
cards.text: Legend: immune to weather, Blaze, Dummy and all boosts. Agile: Street or Rooftops.

cards.name: Lykta
cards.line: A small lantern with big opinions. Brings friends back.
cards.text: Legend: immune to weather, Blaze, Dummy and all boosts. Healer: bring a non-Legend unit back from your discard pile and play it.

cards.name: The Witch
cards.line: She ate the cookies. All of them.
cards.text: Legend: immune to weather, Blaze, Dummy and all boosts.

cards.name: Uncle Rusty
cards.line: Fixes anything with the wrong tool.

cards.name: Kåre the Log
cards.line: A log. Everyone nearby feels quietly inspired.

cards.name: Frost Troll

cards.text: Blaze: if the enemy Street totals 10+, burns its strongest unit(s).

cards.name: Lone Mitten
cards.line: Somebody will come back for it.

cards.name: Konstabel Bror
cards.line: "Please do not feed the SUVs."

cards.name: Ola the Baker
cards.line: Warm, floury, unreasonably calm.

cards.name: Skogkatt
cards.line: Fluffy. Judging you.
cards.text: Agile: Street or Rooftops.

cards.name: Uglefar
cards.line: Hoo. Hoo is there. Hoo is watching.

cards.name: Snømann Sigurd
cards.line: Not here yesterday. Not melting.

cards.name: Ingeborg the Librarian
cards.line: Shhh. SHHH. Lower your power.

cards.name: Brannsjef Torkel
cards.line: Has never met a fire he did not respect.

cards.name: Gunnar the Fishmonger
cards.line: Smells like a promise.

cards.name: Bjørn, Schoolboy
cards.line: Late again. Snowed, apparently.

cards.name: Torill the Teacher
cards.line: Reads your mind. Marks it in red.

cards.name: Farmer Knut
cards.line: Pitchfork. Opinions. Wellies.

cards.name: Mads the Gardener
cards.line: Throws frozen carrots. Accurately.

cards.name: Sven of the Cafe
cards.line: Pours boiling coffee off the balcony.

cards.name: The Book Bus
cards.line: Overdue. Very, very overdue.

cards.name: Even the Skier
cards.line: Cross-country. Cross attitude.

cards.line: Leader. Calls the thaw once per game.
cards.text: Clear all weather.

cards.name: Constable Kleppe
cards.line: Leader. Fines the biggest Workshop.
cards.text: Burn the strongest enemy Workshop unit(s) if the row totals 10+.

cards.line: Leader. Whistles up the fog from the deck.
cards.text: Play Tåke (fog) from your deck.

cards.name: Principal Solvår
cards.line: Leader. Rings the bell: Workshops work twice as hard.
cards.text: Double your Workshop row (like a Yule Horn).

cards.name: Rolv Smokebeard
cards.line: Smells of pipe, pine and trouble. Cheers everyone up.

cards.name: Ragna Firespark
cards.line: Her mittens are on fire. This is normal.

cards.name: Old Orm
cards.line: He was an elder when the first cookie was baked.

cards.name: Sneaky Tuss

cards.name: Berit with the Bow
cards.line: Shoots acorns. Aims at ankles.

cards.name: Twig Kjetil
cards.line: Is there. Then is not there. Then behind you.
cards.text: Agile: Street or Rooftops.

cards.line: Walks in front. Always in front. Never turns around.
cards.text: Agile: Street or Rooftops.

cards.name: Tailor Sander
cards.line: Stitches a hat on anyone who sits still.
cards.text: Agile: Street or Rooftops.

cards.name: Hilde of the Hearth
cards.line: Stirs the pot clockwise. Always clockwise.

cards.name: Pot-Lid Gard
cards.line: Shield: lid. Sword: ladle.

cards.name: Fredrik the Fiddler
cards.line: Plays so well the squirrels cry.

cards.name: Siri Skip

cards.name: Bell Bjella
cards.line: Rings. Everyone turns. Nobody knows why.

cards.name: Slingshot Slyng
cards.line: Fires a pinecone 40 meters. Apologises 80.

cards.name: Cauldron Kobbe
cards.line: Stew: heals the fallen. Smells like Tuesday.

cards.line: Leader. Burns the biggest enemy Street (10+).
cards.text: Burn the strongest enemy Street unit(s) if the row totals 10+.

cards.name: Tuss-Tora
cards.line: Leader. Calls the Snowstorm from the deck.
cards.text: Play Snøstorm (frost) from your deck.

cards.name: Stamp-Master Stein
cards.line: APPROVED. DENIED. APPROVED. He does not look up.

cards.line: Stands. Stares. Says "next".

cards.name: Frost Clerk
cards.line: Fingers frozen to the pen.

cards.name: Blue Archer
cards.line: Fires paper airplanes with intent.

cards.name: Lightning Linn
cards.line: Fast. Short. Static.

cards.name: Filing Golem
cards.line: Made of drawers. Contains your complaint.

cards.name: Rubber-Stamp Press
cards.line: KA-CHUNK. Final.

cards.line: "Halt. Who goes there. Show form 7."

cards.text: Cancel the opponent's leader ability.

cards.name: Mare
cards.line: Sits on your chest. Pays no rent.

cards.name: Lyktemann

cards.name: Spider King
cards.line: Eight legs, nine plans.

cards.line: It is a rock. It is also a bird. Do not discuss.

cards.line: Two giants, one headache.

cards.text: Agile: Street or Rooftops.

cards.line: Turns to stone at sunrise. It is not sunrise.

cards.name: Fog Foglet
cards.line: Fog with feelings.

cards.name: Whale Catapult

cards.name: Fjord Pony
